questions.questionText: A classroom floor is 33 m long and 12 m wide. Tiles cover 1 m² each. How many tiles are needed to cover the floor, ignoring wastage?
questions.explanation: Calculate the area in square metres.

questions.questionText: A rectangular box is 10 cm long, 9 cm wide and 7 cm high. Calculate its volume in cm³.
questions.explanation: V=l×w×h.
